subject: Welcome — pick a 20-min developer walkthrough
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@brightlane.com>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Welcome — pick a 20-min developer walkthrough

Hi Samira —

Thanks for signing up and trying Redwood Inference! I wanted to get you a quick path to a short developer walkthrough (20 minutes) so your engineer can see the runtime and try a quick model call.

If this works, grab a slot on my team’s shared calendar: https://cal.redwood.com/e/rdw-20min-quicklink-abc

Suggested agenda (20 min):
- 3 min intro + your goals
- 10 min run-through: local example and latency/cost discussion
- 5 min quick Q&A + next steps

If you prefer, send over a few windows that work for you (include timezone) and we’ll match. Also feel free to CC any teammates who should join. I attached a 1‑page quickstart that many eng teams find useful.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
SDR, Redwood Inference
Attachment: quickstart-one-pager.pdf (1 page, PDF)
From: Samira Khan <samira@brightlane.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 10:05:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Welcome — pick a 20-min developer walkthrough

Thanks, Vivek — appreciate the quick reply.

A couple notes:
- Afternoon PST is best for us (1pm-4pm PT) or early morning CET if that’s easier for your team.
- Can you include our ML engineer, Alex Li (alex.li@brightlane.com)? He’ll do the technical evaluation.
- We’re particularly interested in how Redwood handles KV cache behavior for shorter-turnaround chat workloads and autoscaling for bursty traffic.

I tried the calendar link but our Calendly blocks external links from some domains — if you can propose a few explicit times that’d be great.

Cheers,
Samira Khan
Head of Product, Brightlane
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@brightlane.com>, Alex Li <alex.li@brightlane.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 11:30:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Welcome — pick a 20-min developer walkthrough

Hi Samira — Monica here from the SDR team, looping in the engineering lead (Karthik) for availability. Thank you for the context — we’ll make sure the walkthrough focuses on KV cache and autoscaling behavior.

I can propose the following 20‑minute windows (all PDT):
- Tue, May 20 — 1:30pm–1:50pm PT
- Wed, May 21 — 2:00pm–2:20pm PT
- Thu, May 22 — 3:00pm–3:20pm PT

If any of those work please reply with the preferred slot and I’ll send a calendar invite. If none work, reply with a couple of windows that do and your timezone and I’ll handle it directly.

Also attaching the one‑pager again and a short runbook link that outlines what we’ll demo (small excerpt + sample command).

Monica Patel
SDR, Redwood Inference
Attachments: quickstart-one-pager.pdf; runbook-demo-snapshot.txt
Related link: https://drive.redwood.com/s/quickstart-one-pager
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@brightlane.com>, Alex Li <alex.li@brightlane.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 11:03:45 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: 20-min developer walkthrough — Tue May 20 1:30pm PT

Thanks, Samira — we’ve confirmed Tue, May 20 1:30pm–1:50pm PT (calendar invite sent). I’ll be the engineer on the call — plan is: quick infra diagram, a short live run (sample prompt + latency/cost printout), and one slide on autoscaling + KV cache defaults.

Invite details (sent to calendar):
- Title: Redwood — 20m developer walkthrough (Brightlane)
- When: Tue, May 20, 2025 1:30 PM – 1:50 PM PT
- Location: Zoom (link in invite)
- Attach: 20min-dev-walkthrough.ics (meeting stub)

If Alex wants us to prepare a short sample that mirrors Brightlane’s chat workload, send a 1–2 example prompts and expected sequence lengths and we’ll load a quick local script for the demo.

See you then —
Karthik Iyer
Staff Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: 20min-dev-walkthrough.ics (calendar invite stub)
